fluff.overview: Capellan infantry serve where BattleMechs and armor cannot be spared, which in the resource-constrained CCAF means nearly everywhere. The Xin Sheng movement revitalized the infantry arm alongside every other facet of the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces, giving foot soldiers better equipment and renewed purpose. Mechanized tracked platoons give Capellan commanders infantry that can keep pace with armored formations across rough terrain. The tracked transports provide better cross-country mobility than wheeled vehicles, allowing these platoons to operate alongside the tanks and combat vehicles that form the CCAF's armored reserve. Flamer sections carry man-portable incendiary weapons that are devastating in close quarters and against fortified positions, though the short range and hazardous fuel supply make flamer duty one of the most dangerous assignments in the platoon.
